## Problem and behavior

Describe the trigger and the resulting behavior. Include a short before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Identify checks not run and why.

## Compatibility

Describe public API, mapping, wire-format or operational changes. Link updated examples and documentation where relevant.

- [ ] Added a regression test for a behavior change, or explained why one is unnecessary.
- [ ] Used official Elasticsearch models/builders where they already provide the required behavior.
- [ ] Updated generated examples and API documentation where affected.
- [ ] Reviewed retry, partial failure and concurrency behavior where affected.
- [ ] Client dependency changes are reflected in the compatibility table and adapter tests.
